modmenu.descriptionTranslation.mythicloo: Hostile mobs you kill can drop weapons, bows, armor, shields and tools with random rarity and affixes: more damage, life steal, true-aim arrows, more health… The higher the mob's level, the better. Designed to be played with Bloodmoon & Bosses and Hero's Forge. Server-side: vanilla clients can join.
mythicloot.afijo.vampirico.descripcion: Steals %s%% of the damage you deal
mythicloot.afijo.ardiente.descripcion.un: Sets targets on fire for 1 second
mythicloot.afijo.ardiente.descripcion.va: Sets targets on fire for %s seconds
mythicloot.afijo.festin.descripcion: Killing an enemy restores %s%% of your health
mythicloot.afijo.lluvia.descripcion: %s%% chance to shoot an extra arrow
mythicloot.afijo.brebaje.descripcion: When hurt, %s%% chance to drink a brew
mythicloot.afijo.llamarada.descripcion: -%s%% fire damage taken; sets attackers on fire
mythicloot.afijo.vacio.descripcion: %s%% chance to dodge an attack by teleporting
